name: castino

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@castino/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@castino/web"

scripts.build:cloud: npm run build --workspace=@castino/shared && npm run build --workspace=@castino/web && npm run build:cloud --workspace=@castino/server
scripts.setup: npm run build --workspace=@castino/shared && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
